Hi Sofia,

Hi Jenna / Brightline AP,

Thanks — happy to get this set up. Short answers up front:
- Billing contact: primary will be Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai). For billing ops and technical delivery we'll use Kimberly Park (kimberly.park@redwood.ai) and Connor O'Brien (connor.obrien@redwood.ai) respectively.
- Delivery: we prefer customers enroll in our Billing Portal (secure SFTP/API + portal UI) for automated processing; however we can send PDF invoice copies to ap@brightline.com during an enrollment/whitelist window.

Proposal: enroll Brightline in the portal and we will enable "Email copy" to ap@brightline.com for a temporary period (we recommend 90 days) while your IT completes whitelisting. After that period, the portal becomes primary and email copies can be turned off on request.

Notes / asks for you:
- Please confirm the AP contact name and whether Brightline requires a specific PO number format to show in the invoice PO field.
- Please attach your VAT certificate (if applicable) so we can tag invoices correctly for EU reverse-charge handling.
- If you need the legacy PDF-only workflow permanently, we can support it but it requires a manual handoff and different SLAs.

I attached a sample invoice XML payload so your AP team can confirm field mapping (PO, remit-to, tax fields). If this plan sounds good I'll loop in Kimberly and Connor to start the portal invite and provide the whitelist IPs/URLs.

Best,

Sofia Ivanova
Account Lead — MidMarket, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai

We'll accept the portal invite. During the 90‑day enrollment window please send PDFs to ap@brightline.com. After that, we will move to portal primary.
